sources.title: Snapshot Interpolation

sources.adopted_scope: Arrival jitter motivates delayed buffering; missing intermediate samples and extrapolation require distinct treatment, not a universally safe delay.

own_example: Server samples (100ms,0) and (200ms,10); arrival paths (120ms,220ms) or (120ms,240ms); assumed exact clock mapping, client current250ms, delay100ms, target150ms. These are stipulated paper inputs, not network observations.
limits: Clock mapping is assumed, not implemented or derived from either article.
Only already decoded, retained, same-object and same-generation samples without a discontinuity are considered.
Linear reconstruction need not equal actual intermediate simulation trajectory.
No network, engine, jitter emulator, latency measurement or new execution.
No universal transport, buffer duration, adaptive clock, loss recovery or hit-compensation guarantee.
